city_secrets.text: Secrets? Plenty. Watch out for the parking lot boys in red and purple... and don't drive into the canal unless you like swimming with synth-eels.

hanging_around.text: Best shadow in the district. The light keeps the corporate drones away, and the dancers over there keep the music loud enough to drown out bad thoughts.

choices.text: "What are you doing hanging under this lamp?"

start.text: Hey there stranger, come talk to an old man?

dodgy_quests.text: Street's always buzzin' if you know where to look. What kind of work are you lookin' for, Banquo?

offer_pink_cadillac.text: Word on the grid is a suspicious hot pink Cadillac is cruisin' through West Park Plaza. Tail it at a safe distance (15m-40m) without raisin' suspicion!

accept_pink_cadillac.text: Good luck out there, Banquo. Keep your distance and don't let 'em spot you!

choices.text: "I'll take the encrypted drive to Porter."

offer_data_drop.text: I got an encrypted Syndicate data-chip that needs to get to Porter at The Pit Garage. You got 90 seconds before the corporate scanners lock it down!

accept_data_drop.text: Run fast, Banquo! The clock is tickin'!

choices.text: "What do you know about this city?"

who_are_you.text: Name's Dodgy. I keep an eye on the park... and the park keeps an eye on me. Quiet corner, if you don't mind the neon smoke.
